title: Silas and the Interior
author: M. M. Fairweather
blurb: Ines Reyes, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
